fact: Order 503-26 of the Ministry of the Interior says registered voters can view their own entries on the electoral lists through the website www.listeselectorales.ma, using their electronic national ID card number with surname or birth date.

Interior Minister Laftit said on 13 January 2026 that the ministry audited the electoral lists in the central information system, and that 254,740 of 382,170 new registrants came via the dedicated electoral-lists website.
system: système d'information central des listes électorales

fact: Morocco's Interior Ministry says voters can check their registration and polling station by SMS to 2727, the electoral-rolls website or the MonBV app, using their national identity card number.
system: General electoral rolls lookup (SMS 2727, website, MonBV app)
